(1) plugins/audit/scripts/_machine_paths.py: _MACHINE_PATH_SHAPES rows are now (name, pattern, needles). Needles, described rather than spelled (the writer refuses their spellings): posix-home - each home word followed by a forward slash; windows-user-path - the Users word followed by one backslash, and a pair of backslashes; session-slug - each home word between two dashes, and the private-tmp slug; escaped-path - the three percent-escaped home spellings its arms take (case-folded, the pattern is re.I); tempdir-session - the claude scratch directory under tmp, the var-folders pair, and the backslashed Temp spelling (case-folded); unexpanded-home - the tilde followed by a slash. NEEDLE = _needle_alternation(_MACHINE_PATH_SHAPES) - one compiled alternation built from the rows, each needle wrapped in (?i:...) exactly where its row's pattern carries re.IGNORECASE. machine_path_shape unpacks three. outcome.descriptive: The committed-PII scan skips lines carrying none of a shape's mandatory needles and remembers each file's rows by content. One full scan drops from about 10 s to about 1.7 s and the tool's suite from about 72 to about 18 slot-seconds. The prefilter is held by a strip-and-assert case and a full-domain equivalence case that prove-gates proves red.
